claims.says: Pushing any ids below 2^64 onto a well-formed IdList, with the real bitmap-collapse arithmetic, always succeeds, keeps it well-formed, and appends the ids in push order, counting each.
If the roaring codec round-trips, building a list from fewer than 2^32 ids below 2^64, encoding it and decoding the bytes gives back the same segments and exactly the pushed ids in order.
If the roaring codec behaves and count is below 2^32, anything read_ids accepts from a byte list is well-formed segments totalling count ids, at most count of them, read from an input prefix.
On any input bytes and any record count, the modelled read_ids decoder never ends in a panic.
